description: Connect your NAFA account to read your workout plan and history, update an exercise, and read, log or correct food entries with calories, macros and fibre. Choose separate read and edit permissions, revoke access at any time, and confirm every change before it is saved. Biomarkers, body measurements, sensor health metrics, medical records and photos are not available through this plugin.

defaultPrompt: Summarize my logged food, calories, protein and fibre for the last seven days.
Show my current workout plan and summarize my recent workout history.
Help me log a snack. Show me the entry and ask for confirmation before saving.
